intro.text: Now the right hand: 6 and 7 for your right index finger, 8 middle, 9 ring and 0 for your little finger.
intro.tip: Some typists reach 6 with the left hand – here we use the right index finger, matching the finger guide.

steps.title: Meet 6, 7, 8, 9, 0
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: The year has 365 days and 12 months. My phone number ends in 7890. We walked 6 miles in 2 hours.
There were 1000 people at the match. Train 9 leaves at 8. A week has 7 days and 168 hours.
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out – trust your fingers!
